releaseBlockers: ghostshell-90w9: Renew the managed-closure approval for stock SqlClient and the shared connection backend before publication.

managedComponents.comment: The previous owner decision accepted the documented SMBLibrary Native AOT replacement path, remaining Inter provenance exception, SSH.NET 2026.0.0 and SharpCompress 0.50.3 without independent legal review. Those exceptions are retained. This revised closure replaces the SqlClient source fork with official Microsoft.Data.SqlClient 6.0.2 MIT NuGet provenance and adds the first-party connection backend; renewed owner acceptance is pending. The Linux sidecar has a separate exact catalog and approval record.

nativeTerminalAndShell.comment: The project owner accepts the pinned libghostty-vt closure and retained GPL-covered shell resources for this exact macOS closure, including the pinned MIT Porta.Pty-native 1.0.7-ghostshell.1 descriptor-boundary patch and its retained source, license and build evidence.

cefMacos.comment: The project owner accepts the exact macOS CEF license and Chromium credits, including CEF 150.0.9+g81b0088+chromium-150.0.7871.46 and the 0.8.0-ghostshell.10 binding source and patch evidence, and owns the security-update decision.
